title: Snap, then Hold
description: Thay đổi xảy ra gần như trong một khung, chỉ phần lắng xuống có ease, rồi giữ yên để cảm giác chắc tay.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-snaphold, written here): Four stars, 450 ms apart: each appears at once at scale 1.25 (no in-between frames), holds 60 ms, settles 1.25 → 1 in 200 ms power2.out, then holds. Recipe: the change itself in 40–80 ms (1–2 frames), settle to 300 ms (expo.out), then hold. Params: pop (1.25) · snap (60 ms) · settle (0.2 s) · hold (≥ 0.6 s). The change itself takes 1–2 frames; only the settle is eased, then it holds still.
